svg.title: 14 orbit conservation and refinement
svg.desc: Synthetic two-body conservation and refinement diagnostics from immutable model outputs. Panel A scales relative specific-energy error to parts per million and reports angular-momentum conservation for the stored 400-step-per-period run. Panel B compares three recorded maximum-energy errors with a second-order reference anchored to the coarsest run. This is an integration check, not trajectory prediction validation.
